prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access right now, so I can’t look up current ratings. Do you mean spray (airbrush) tanning or UV tanning beds? Preferences (price, privacy, organic solution, mobile service, evening hours) will change which place is “best” for you.

If you want, tell me which type you prefer and any must-haves and I’ll recommend exactly what to look for and give a short phone-check script. Meanwhile, here are quick, practical steps to find the best salon in Pleasanton:

How to choose the best salon
- Pick type: spray (safer) or UV beds (higher skin risk).  
- Use Google Maps or Yelp, search “spray tan Pleasanton” or “tanning salon Pleasanton.”  
- Filter by rating (4.0+), sort by “Most Reviewed” or “Highest Rated” and read reviews from the last 6–12 months.  
- Check photos and before/after shots; look for consistent results and clean facilities.  
- Confirm staff training and product info (brand of spray solution, organic or DHA-free if you care).  
- For UV beds: ask about bulb age/wattage, bed maintenance, eye protection, and skin consultations.  
- Compare pricing, first-time specials, package deals, and cancellation policy.  
- Look up the salon on Instagram or Facebook for recent client photos and sanitized environment evidence.

Quick phone script to evaluate a salon
- “Hi — I’m a first-time client. Do you offer [spray tans / stand-up/tanning beds]? Are technicians certified? What solution/brand do you use? Do you have before/after photos? Any first-time specials? How do you sanitize between clients?”

Safety note
- If you’re considering UV beds, know they increase skin cancer risk; limit sessions and follow staff guidance. Spray tanning is much safer for skin tone without UV exposure.

Tell me whether you want spray or UV and any preferences (budget, late hours, mobile service), and I’ll give a tailored recommendation and the exact searches/phrases to use to find the top-rated salons now.
